lines.en: Jumada al-Akhir | 30 | 7 | so since the fraction of twenty-nine days, which is twelve hours and forty-four minutes, is more than half a day and night

lines.en: Dhu al-Qa'dah al-Haram | 29 | hd | it was, then they took it as twenty-nine, and until the end of the year on this analogy they took one month as thirty and one as twenty-nine

lines.text: ذي حجه الحرام | ٣٠ | ٤٤ | روز و اگر كسر زايد نصف شبانه روزي سه بود يعني همين دوازده ساعت و

lines.text: پس ششماه سي ميگرفتند و ششماه بيست و نه روز و در اخر سال كسري نميماند ليكن چهل و

lines.text: چهار دقيقه از دوازده ساعت زياده است كه در اخر سال هشت ساعت و چهل و هشت دقيقه
lines.en: four minutes is more than twelve hours, which at the end of the year is eight hours and forty-eight minutes

lines.text: كه حاصل الضرب دقايق مذكور است در عدد شهور بر سر آمده و انرا فضل السنه
lines.en: which is the product of the multiplication of the mentioned minutes by the number of months, has come over, and they call it the excess of the year

lines.text: خوانند و لا محاله ان سدس و خمس شبانروزيست و ما طريق اين حسابرا در جدول
lines.en: and inevitably it is a sixth and a fifth of a day and night, and we have brought the method of this calculation in a table

lines.text: اورديم تا معلوم شود كه در اول هر ماهي كسر چه مقدار است و چند بحجه نقصان ماه
lines.en: so that it becomes known how much the fraction is at the beginning of every month, and how much by reason of the deficiency of the month

lines.text: مقدم حساب شده و چند مانده و جدول اينست و در سي سال يازده سال از ان كبيسه
lines.en: preceding has been calculated, and how much remains, and the table is this, and in thirty years, eleven years of it are leap years

summary.headline: Lunar Months and Leap Years
summary.text: Explanation of the lunar year’s 29-day 12-hour 44-minute synodic month, alternating 30- and 29-day months according to fractional remainders, and the resulting annual excess of 8 hours 48 minutes. A month-by-month table gives the fractions and corrections, followed by the rule that eleven of every thirty years are leap years.
